value.signature: fn compare_body (body : & ProposalBody , expected_body : & ProposalBody) -> Result < () , ProfileError >

review.body: { body_projection (body) ? ; body_projection (expected_body) ? ; if body != expected_body { return Err (ProfileError :: Body) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: Both B3 bodies are public; this reports exact structural equality, not an authenticated opening.
